description: Return the workspace node tree. Pass `root_path` to scope to a subtree and/or `depth` to limit how many levels below it are returned — do this on large monorepos instead of pulling every node. Omit both for the full tree. Use for navigation + planning; prefer pathrule_get_context when you just need the closest node for the caller's cwd.

depth.description: Max levels below root_path (0 = only the root node itself). Omit for unlimited depth.

root_path.description: Scope to this subtree (workspace-relative, e.g. '/packages/app'). Omit for the whole tree.

name: pathrule_get_tree
title: Get Workspace Tree
